children: Digi International (

), a leading global provider of IoT connectivity products, services and solutions, today announced the completion of its $130 million cash acquisition of Disruptive Technologies (DT), a global leader in advanced sensing technology. The transaction closed on November 24, 2026 following receipt of a required regulatory approval in the United Kingdom. Disruptive Technologies will join SmartSense by Digi, advancing its physical-world intelligence platform through expanded sensing capabilities.
This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261124402469/en/
Digi International Completes Acquisition of Disruptive Technologies, Expanding SmartSense Physical-World Intelligence Capabilities

Disruptive Technologies has developed advanced micro-manufacturing capabilities, which enable the company to produce postage-stamp-sized, ultra-low-power wireless sensors with a battery life of up to 15 years. The rich data captured from these industry-leading sensors complements SmartSense ONE, a monitoring, compliance and analytics platform that turns sensor data into operational insights and actions.

Through enterprise workflows, analytics and corrective actions, SmartSense ONE connects environmental data with broader operational context. This helps organizations turn intelligence into improved compliance, reliability, efficiency, and revenue. The addition of Disruptive Technologies also extends SmartSense into new industries and applications, including building management and occupancy sensing.

“Digi is thrilled to close our acquisition of Disruptive Technologies. Erik Fossum Færevaag and his talented team at DT will join forces with Guy Yehiav’s SmartSense team, establishing leadership in helping protect the world’s food and health care,” said Ron Konezny, CEO of Digi International. “DT provides world-class, unique sensor solutions that will bring new ROI opportunities for our existing customers, expand us into Europe, and open new verticals in building automation.”

“The physical world is constantly generating information, but much of that intelligence has historically been difficult to capture in real-time and act upon quickly,” said Guy Yehiav, President of SmartSense by Digi. “With Disruptive Technologies now part of SmartSense, we’re changing that, combining advanced sensing technology with enterprise software and operational workflows to drive smarter, more informed decisions. We’re thrilled to welcome the Disruptive Technologies team as we bring these capabilities to more customers, industries and markets.”

“We built Disruptive Technologies around a simple belief: sensors should be small, reliable and easy to deploy anywhere,” said Erik Fossum Færevaag, CEO of Disruptive Technologies. “That vision has driven our innovation in ultra-low-power sensing and advanced micro-manufacturing, making it possible to capture information from environments and assets that have traditionally been difficult to monitor. Joining SmartSense gives us the opportunity to accelerate that innovation, push the boundaries of what sensing technology can achieve and unlock entirely new applications across industries.”

Following its acquisitions of Jolt and Disruptive Technologies, SmartSense is merging a trusted ecosystem of asset monitoring and operational intelligence within SmartSense ONE. This holistic approach to physical-world intelligence is already benefiting customers like RaceTrac, which operates 615 retail fuel convenience stores across the southern United States. RaceTrac uses more than 8,000 Disruptive Technologies sensors to monitor temperature, humidity, doors and equipment, in tandem with the SmartSense ONE Operate module to anticipate equipment issues.

“At RaceTrac, we’re using sensors from Disruptive Technologies to understand what’s happening across our stores, while SmartSense ONE Operate helps our teams execute consistently and respond quickly to changing conditions,” said Drew Gardner, Director of Operations and Enterprise Resiliency at RaceTrac. “Bringing these capabilities together creates an exciting opportunity to move beyond monitoring individual assets toward a more complete understanding of our operations. Ultimately, it’s about making better decisions, protecting product availability and giving our store teams more time to focus on guests.”

SmartSense will showcase its expanded capabilities, including technology from Disruptive Technologies, at NRF 2027: Retail’s Big Show, January 10–12, 2027, at the Javits Center in New York City. Visit SmartSense at booths 1300 and 334, or schedule a virtual meeting.
About SmartSense by Digi
SmartSense by Digi, a business unit of Digi International (

), is a leading global provider of IoT Sensing as a Service solutions delivering asset tracking, monitoring, process digitization, and digital decisioning across key verticals. For more information, visit www.smartsense.co.
About Disruptive Technologies

Disruptive Technologies is a global leader in advanced sensing technology, combining compact form factors, ultra-low-power design, extended battery life and advanced connectivity with rapid development and manufacturing capabilities.
About Digi International
Digi International (

) is a leading global provider of IoT connectivity products, services, and solutions. Digi helps businesses and mission-critical industries discover the value of connected devices and the data they provide. From embedded modules and routers to enterprise software and managed services, Digi's end-to-end solutions help customers deploy, monitor, and manage their connected infrastructure with confidence. Digi is headquartered in Hopkins, Minnesota. For more information, visit digi.com.
